book.name: Galatians
book.title: Galatians Saint Paul, Galatia Nahkat Gwa'an Gwik'injiighit Nąįį ts'ą' Ch'adąąnt'tł'oo

content: Deegoo'ya' Gwiindhan Ąįį Gwik'it T'igwii'in Ąįį Gwaroontą'
Ideenjit k'eedeegwarahaadhat eenjit Christ diineenjit gwiłtsąįį. Chan Moses va-law ts'ą' slaves ǫhłį' shrǫ'!
Ch'oodǫǫhk'įį! Shįį Paul t'ihchy'aa, jii nakhwaa gwahaldak: nakhwadhah gihłeerohoht'ii shrǫ'! Gwik'it t'akhwazhik ji', Christ vat'oohchy'aa kwaa k'it t'ohchy'aa.
Chan hee jyaa nakhwahaihjyaa, juu nakhwatee vadhah gihłeerihiłt'uu ji', jidii Law datthak k'eegwahahthat gwizhrįh.

Juu Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa eenjit gwinzii t'ii'in niindhan ts'ą' Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa va-law k'eegwahthat ji', ąįįt'ee Christ duuyeh neeyahshii, Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vich'eegoonzhrii eh'ok hee gwitr'it t'agwah'in t'ii'in.
Diikhwan ąįį, Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vaa tr'eedaa ji' eenjit gwizhrįh niinjich'aradhat, izhit t'ee geenjit nagwarool'in t'oonchy'aa, Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą vat'aii zhit gwik'injigwiighit tr'ii'įį haa.
Christ Jesus vaa tr'iinlii ji', diidhah gihłeerahaht'ii gwit'eegwaahchy'aa kwaa. Gwik'injigwiighit zhit ch'eet'igwiniindhan tr'ii'įį ąįį zhrįh gwit'eegwaahchy'aa.
Jesus vatąįį ohdaa łyaa gwinzii t'akhwa'in chy'aa! Juu łi'didlii k'eegohthat kwaa nakhwiłtsąįį? Nats'ąą gwik'it t'akhwa'in nakhwiłtsąįį?
Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa gwitee tr'anakhweiinlii ąįį t'iizhik kwaa.
“Łųh vaaniituu tsal haa nahshii dąį' googaa vaa łųhchy'aa lęįį gwilik.” Gwinyąą.

Gaa tth'aii hee K'eegwaadhat k'injohkhit nakhwaashandaii, nakhwan, shįį haa Diik'eegwaadhat vaa nareelzhii ts'ą' duuyeh ch'ijuk ts'ąįį gooh'in nakhwaashandaii ts'ą' ąįį juu veh'an t'akhwazhik ąįį Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa yagwahąąhshii t'oonchy'aa.

Shachaa nąįį, diidhah gihłeerahaht'al eenjit geech'ǫąąłtan, geh'an jaghaii shats'ą' nich'itsigahthat t'igii'in? Jyaa t'ishi'in ji' zhit Christ giriłtsak ts'ą' niindhat eech'oaałtan ąįį łi'didlii heelyaa kwaa.
Ąįį juu iizųų nakhwahtsii nąįį gwandaa t'igii'in ji' goovoihnyąą, castrate adagaatsii, ts'ą' seenjaa jyaa digii'in zhyaa goovoh'in!

Shachaa nąįį, nakhwan ąįį (slaves) hohłyaa kwaa eenjit gwitee tr'anakhwariinlii, gwiizųų vaa tr'agahoh'yaa eenjit kwaa gaa Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vich'eet'igwiniindhan haa ch'izhii nąįį haa gwitr'it t'agohoh'yaa eenjit t'inchy'aa.
Jii Law datthak jyaa nyąą t'inyąą: “Deegwahtł'oo ideet'iindhan gwik'it ch'izhii nąįį chan eet'iindhan.”
Gaa nin iizųų k'it t'akhwa'in ts'ą' ch'izhii nąįį ts'ahahthaa gwik'eegwiindaii; ąįį łyaa gook'ǫǫhtii, datthak nakhwatee googwąąnchy'aa ts'ą' an nihłahootsyaa t'oonchy'aa.
Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą, ts'ą' Dinjii Haa
Jii ąįį jyaa t'ihnyąą: Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą deeni'in datthak naa oolį', tr'ihkhit adats'ą' k'eegoodhat hohłyaa kwaa!

Dinjii tr'iinlii ts'ą' deegoo'ya' gwiindhan ąįį Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą gitr'ii'ee, ts'ą' Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą doo'ya' diinoonyąą ąįį dinjii tr'iinlii ts'ą' deegoo'ya' gwiindhan ąįį gitr'ii'ee. Jii neekwaii nąįį diizhit nihjyaa ginlii kwaa, ąįį geh'an adats'ą' k'eegwaraadhat kwaa t'oonchy'aa.
Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą deekhwa'in datthak nakhwaa nilii ji', Jews goo-law zhit ohdaa gwat'aahchy'aa kwaa.
Dinjii tr'iinlii ts'ą' deegwii'in datthak gwizhrįh gwigweech'in. Diitthąį' haa gwiizųų diigwitr'it gwanlii, nihts'ą' gwiizųų niinjich'aradhat, ginilih kwaa diigwitr'it gwanlii,

ch'ik'itiltsį' ts'ą' khadigiriinjii, shan chan haanigwirii'aii, haa dinjii nąįį nihłitr'igii'ee ts'ą' nihłigiighan, gootr'eegwąhgąįį ts'ą' nankat gwik'eiich'ii lęįį giindhan. Nihłehts'į' t'igiichy'aa haa tthok nineegiidal.

Dinjii goovandaa nizįį nąįį itr'igii'ee, ch'anagahoonį' gwiizhit giinlęįį haa nihłaanigwigwii'ąįį ts'ą' nihts'ą' gwiizųų tr'agogwah'in. Gwehkįį dąį' jyaa nakhwaiinyą' gaa chan hee jyaa nakhwahaihjyaa: jii juu jyąhts'ą' googwitr'it gwanlii nąįį duuyeh Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa Veegwinii'ee gwąąh'in t'oonchy'aa.

Gaa Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą zhrįh eh'an jii kwaii gwanlii t'oonchy'aa: Ch'eet'igwiniindhan, shrigweheechy'aa, tsinehdan, khai' t'iichy'aa, veeshroonchy'aa, yit'injihaahchy'aa, vich'eegoonzhrii, nihts'ą' tr'iheezyaa ts'ą' idik'eerahaantyaa. Jii kwaii eenjit Law kwaa t'oonchy'aa.
Juu Christ Jesus vats'anh nilii nąįį dinjii ginlii gwizhit gwiizųų t'asho'ya' giindhan ąįį ęhdaa tr'igwigwehee'aa haa nihk'it t'oonchy'aa.
Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą ąįį gwandaii diinantł'eiin'ąįį, diigwandaii ts'ą' k'eedeegwaadhat goo'aii.
Ch'it'injarahaa'aa kwaa goo'aii, nihts'ą' tr'iiheezųų kwaa goo'aii, ch'izhii dinjii jidii gwii'įį chan gwiheenghyaa kwaa goo'aii.
